hxlistextended.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit extended list API.

An extended list is a list where the items can be customized by applications. The items in an extended list can contain multiple strings as well as images. The application is called when each item in the list needs to be drawn.

HxResult HxListExtendedAddItem ( HxListExtended_t *  pList,
int32_t *  pIndex 
)

Add an item to a list.

HxListExtendedAddItem adds a new item to the list. Unlike HxListAddItem, no string or icon is associated with the new item, since the application is responsible for maintaining this information.

The incoming pIndex argument is the index into the array of items where the item should be inserted. If pIndex is less than 0, or if pIndex is greater than the existing number of items in the list, the new item is appended to the list. The index where the new item was inserted is returned in the outgoing pIndex.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
pIndex IN/OUT: Pointer to index where item is to be inserted
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR is a memory error occurs.

Add an selectable/unselectable item to a list.

HxListExtendedAddSelectableItem adds a new item to the list. It behaves as HxListExtendedAddItem except it accepts a flag selectable to specify if the added item is selectable or not.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
pIndex IN/OUT: Pointer to index where item is to be inserted
selectable IN: flag determining if item is selectable or not
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR is a memory error occurs.

HxResult HxListExtendedDelete ( HxListExtended_t *  pList  ) 

Delete an extended list widget.

HxListExtendedDelete deletes a list created from an earlier call to HxListExtendedNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxListExtendedDelete only needs to be called when removing an extended list at runtime.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxListExtendedGetSelection ( HxListExtended_t *  pList,
int32_t  selectionIndex,

)

Get the current selection.

HxListExtendedGetSelection returns the index of the item in an extended list that is highlighted. *pIndex is set to kHxListNoSelection if no item is highlighted.

The selectionIndex is an index between 0 and the selected count obtained with HxListGetSelectionCount.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
selectionIndex IN: index of the selection to get
pIndex OUT: Pointer to the index of highlighted item
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxListExtendedRemoveItem ( HxListExtended_t *  pList,
int32_t  index 
)

Remove an item from a list.

HxListExtendedRemoveItem removes an item from a list.

HX_INVALID_ARG is returned if index is less than 0. Since the index into the array of list items is zero-based, HX_INVALID_ARG is also returned if index is greater or equal to the number of items in the list.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
index IN: Index of item to be removed
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if index is invalid.

HxResult HxListExtendedSetSelection ( HxListExtended_t *  pList,
HxListSelectionAttributes_t  attribute,
int32_t  index 
)

Set the current selection.

HxListExtendedSetSelection highlights an item in an extended list. The zero-based index can be set to kHxListNoSelection if no item should be highlighted.

If the selected item is not visible, the list is scrolled appropriately.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
attribute IN: type of selection made.
index IN: Pointer to index of item, or kHxListNoSelection
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if index is not kHxListNoSelection and is not a valid index. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if item is not selectable.

HxResult HxListExtendedSetTypedownCallback ( HxListExtended_t *  pList,
HxListExtendedTypedownCallback  pCallback,
void *  pData 
)

Set the list typedown callback.

HxListExtendedSetTypedownCallback sets the typedown callback and its associated data. The callback is called when a list receives character that it does not process. Note that callback receives a buffer of recently received characters. The buffer is reset if no characters are received withing 1 second interval

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
pCallback IN: Pointer to the callback function
pData IN: Pointer to the data passed back to the callback function
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxListExtendedUpdateItem ( HxListExtended_t *  pList,
int32_t  index 
)

Update the item on a list.

HxListExtendedUpdateItem redraws an item in a list by calling the item's draw callback. If the item is not visible due to the scrolled state of the list, this function does nothing, and returns HX_OK.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
index IN: Index of the item to redraw
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful, if Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if the list does not contain an item with the index.
